examples.purpose: Add Item inside a Form Upload, the guide's In context: the field “Identity documents” with its support text, one of two attachments added, shown as a preview cell, and the add cell for the second. Form Upload builds the Add Item cells itself from attachments. The uri is a placeholder for the app's file; the onAttachmentsChange stub and the picker stub stand for the app's own list of files and its picker.
examples.jsx:
<FormUpload
  label="Identity documents"
  supportText="Add a clear image and keep the filename nearby."
  attachments={[{ uri: 'https://example.com/receipt-september.svg', name: 'receipt-september.svg' }]}
  maxCount={2}
  picker={async () => ({ assets: [] })}
  onAttachmentsChange={() => {}}
/>

from.quote: The public composite supplies the field label, support text, attachment row, picker handoff, and controlled attachment list.

examples.purpose: A chosen receipt with a meaningful label beside it, the guide's Do “Keep a meaningful label nearby”: a preview Add Item with its remove control, next to the text “Receipt · September”. The uri is a placeholder for the chosen image, onRemove stands for the screen clearing the attachment, and accessibilityLabel names the preview.
examples.jsx:
<HStack alignVertical="center">
  <Additem
    state="preview"
    imageSource="https://example.com/receipt-september.svg"
    onRemove={() => {}}
    accessibilityLabel="Receipt attachment preview"
  />
  <Text text="Receipt · September" />
</HStack>

from.quote: The attachment remains identifiable even when the image is small.

examples.purpose: Adding is unavailable, with the reason nearby, the guide's Do “Explain why adding is unavailable”: a dimmed empty Add Item (isDisabled) above the text that tells people what to do next. accessibilityLabel names the add cell.

notes: Extracted 31 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/additem.guide.tsx, which only registers AddItemGuide, and the Add Item parts of the shared src/ActionGuides.tsx: additemModes, AdditemExample, FormUploadExample, AdditemPlayground and additemSections; the ActionFooter and ActionTile parts belong to other guides and are not cited) and docs/evidence/additem.md at cba512f (8 October, “publish the 5 October Coin build's component fixes”). cba512f is on origin/main; the three files read the same on origin/main and origin/docs-next and have not changed since. The copy snapshot has no playground section, so the playground's notes (Local sample, Remove affordance) are not quoted; its Remove affordance note says what the Sources note says. Dates: the Sources note was checked on 8 October 2026 on “0.1.78 (5 October build)”, Biscuit's main at 636f3f5 (pushed 5 October), and the evidence's 636f3f5 check has the same date and build, so items citing either carry 2026-10-08 and 0.1.78-636f3f5; both are the installed package version, so the trace check does not flag them. The evidence's first section (“Additem guide evidence”) is undated and comes from the 19 September guide on 0.1.60 (the 636f3f5 check says the Sources note “was 0.1.60”); nothing is cited from it. Its remove line (line 10: onTouchEnd, the preview remained after a mouse click and Enter, a 29 × 29 button with no accessible name) is superseded by the 636f3f5 check (#188 fixed) and left out; its other lines (the export and its props, the default inner modes, FormUpload as the in-context composite, the story ids) agree with the 636f3f5 check, the facts and the guide body, which are cited instead. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-636f3f5 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (7 commits) is cut off at 300 files, so blobs were compared: Additem.tsx (096cf0d), FormUpload.tsx (5f4b060), IconCapsule.tsx (f4496d2), Icon.tsx (cddaa05), figma-variables-resolver.ts (d03e77c), JFSThemeProvider.tsx (fa8a86a), react-utils.ts (bd10632), lib/commonjs Additem.js (101b4bf) and Additem.d.ts (40c710d) are the same blobs at 636f3f5, dbe0e02 and in node_modules; the history of src/design-tokens and src/components/FormUpload on dbe0e02 ends at 692e681 (the 636f3f5 mirror commit, 8 October), so token values are as the 8 October check read them; Image.tsx changed once (8e2a35e, 17 October: the loading Skeleton's visible prop only; Additem passes no loading). Additem.tsx last changed between 0.1.77 (86026f0) and 636f3f5 (692e681): the #188 fix. So nothing the 8 October check read has changed. Every guide and evidence sentence quoted here was read against the installed source (read, not rendered; token values through the package's own getVariableByName in lib/commonjs, Light, with Additem's Neutral, Low and S): the cell is a fixed 44 × 44 (Additem.tsx 115–118, 206–220) with the compareCardItem tokens, an rgb(235, 235, 237) fill, radius 8 and 6 px horizontal and 8 px vertical padding, overflow hidden, and opacity 0.5 while isDisabled; empty is one Pressable button holding an ic_add IconCapsule (263–275); preview is a View (carrying testID) holding an absolute-fill Pressable button named by the label, the Image (cover, 28 px tall, radius 6) with pointerEvents none, and, only when onRemove is set, a sibling remove Pressable at top 2, right 2 (zIndex 1, hitSlop 4), named “Remove” plus the label (aria-label on the web), holding an ic_close IconCapsule (225–260), so a click, a tap or Enter on it calls onRemove and not the preview's onPress; handlePress returns while isDisabled; in empty with picker it awaits the picker and passes non-empty assets to onAssetsPicked (a cancel or an error returns, an error warns in development), otherwise it calls onPress (171–196); handleRemove ignores presses while disabled (198–202); the default label is “Add attachment” or “Attachment preview” (204); the inner modes are Neutral, Low and S, under the provider's and the prop's modes (129–134, 161–167); IconCapsule Size S resolves to a 29 px capsule with a transparent fill and an 18 px rgb(36, 38, 43) icon. No sentence quoted here is contradicted. “Preview needs an image source” holds as advice: with no imageSource the Image is an empty View (Image.tsx 213–215), so the cell shows only its grey fill. Tickets, read on the board (read only): #149 (Documentation, Done, live 19 September): Codex's 19 September comments record the remove limitation (preview removal failed with mouse and Enter); #188 (Component Fix, Done, live 8 October) fixed it on 636f3f5, and the installed source confirms it, so it is not a gap. #149's Figma link names node 27-854 in the Coin Subcomponents file, while the guide's Sources says the exact node is unresolved; Figma could not be checked in this run (reported to the coordinator). Storybook: the published index (31 October) has the six stories the evidence lists (default, preview, preview-with-remove, with-picker, disabled, all-states) and the docs page, as the Sources card says. Strength: no quoted rule holds an absolute word; the only one in the copy is the Remove affordance anatomy note (“Appears only when onRemove is supplied for a preview.”), an anatomy part, not a rule. Nothing is required: no prop is required in the facts and the guide has no everywhere-absolute. Default-value facts (state empty; the inner IconCapsule defaults) back recommended rules only. avoidWhen rests on the In context (“Use Additem inside FormUpload” and its description), scoped to a whole upload field (useInstead FormUpload, which has an entry): Sizing's “A FormUpload or another public layout owns row gaps, wrapping, and the surrounding label.” and the Do & Don'ts (a cell beside a Text in an HStack or a VStack) show single cells in other layouts. Anatomy required: only the cell is always present; the Add icon shows only in empty, the Thumbnail only in preview, the Remove affordance only with onRemove. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode and no other modes (the guide's additemModes sets Color Mode Light, Context Default, Page type MainPage, Semantic Intent Brand and the Neutral, Low and S that Additem defaults to; surfaceModes sets Color Mode, Context and Page type on the HStack, VStack and Text); the guide's docs wrappers (data-coin-example divs, comparison cards), its FormUpload accessibilityLabel (“Identity document attachments”) and testID, and the readout “1 of 2 attachments selected” (a docs line, not Coin) are left out; the bundled receipt illustration is a placeholder uri. Example 1 is the In context (a FormUpload with one attachment named receipt-september.svg, maxCount 2, and the picker as a typed stub, async () => ({ assets: [] }), since picker must return a promise); example 2 the first Do (HStack with alignVertical center, a preview with onRemove and the guide's accessibilityLabel, and the Text); example 3 the third Do (VStack, a disabled empty cell, and the reason Text). FormUpload, HStack and VStack have entries; Text has an undocumented entry. Left out of examples (three at most): the anatomy specimens, the Configuration and States cards, the Sizing hosts, the Content filename row, the Don'ts, the second Do (it repeats example 2 with “Receipt selected”) and the playground. Not recorded: the modes collections (building rules; the modes fact's defaults are recorded); the evidence's Figma component key; the Sources note's “(5 October build)” sentence (the version is the installed one and Additem is unchanged since; a guide re-check would say 27 October); “The exact Figma node remains unverified.” (a source limitation, not a Coin gap; reported); Additem cells in a FormUpload's children slot (neither guide shows it); inside a FormUpload the preview's remove capsule takes Neutral, Medium and XS (FormUpload.tsx 131–135, 193–196: an 18 px rgb(84, 89, 97) capsule with a 12 px white icon), while a standalone Add Item's takes Neutral, Low and S (29 px, transparent, dark icon): source reading only, no guide sentence; non-image files (the FormUpload entry's first gap says previews show images only; this guide's Thumbnail note says “visual asset”, and its evidence does not say it, so no gap here); FormUpload's 45 × 44 Figma cell (its evidence only; this guide has no Figma node); dark mode. Gaps: none; #188 is fixed and the evidence names no open ticket. Cross-check: round 1 raised no flags. Its notes point at the evidence's superseded 19 September remove line (reported as a candidate evidence fix), at “a tap” (the Sources note's word; the 636f3f5 QA records a mouse click and Enter; on the installed source the remove control is a Pressable whose onPress handles touch, which also worked before #188), and at /useWhen/1 restating the core principle (kept, as other entries do). Consistency with related entries: FormUpload's entry (cba512f, batch 3) agrees: 44 × 44 cells whose row sets the spacing (8 px), each remove button named after its file and working with a click, a tap or Enter, disabled cells dimmed once with adding and removing blocked, and the field supplying the label, support text, picker and controlled attachments; it does not record children (custom cells), and neither does this entry. IconCapsule's entry does not name Add Item. ActionFooter and ActionTile come from the same shared file; their parts are not cited. Other guidance files name “Add item” only as unrelated labels (AppBar's IconButton, ComparisonBar's slot label). Category: input, as in pack.json. Nothing hand-written here, in the guide's Add Item parts, in the evidence or in the installed Additem, FormUpload and IconCapsule source uses the shape word Coin doesn't have.
